issues.text: New sentence (apply-review r1) makes a claim about Git behaviour that is not in the claims ledger. It is broadly true of a merge conflict (Git stops and leaves the file for the user to resolve), but strategy options such as `-X ours` resolve conflicting hunks without asking, so 'stopped and asked' is not universal.
issues.quote: Unlike a Git conflict, nobody is stopped and asked to choose; a rule decides.
issues.fix: Either add a claim (version_key git, source git-merge docs) or soften to: "Unlike a typical Git merge conflict, where Git stops for you to choose, here nobody is asked; a rule decides."
